args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate (0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Monitoring for recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback completed successfully (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure and the rollback.

4. **Verified recovery** — Post-rollback status shows `checkout-api` on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate dropped to 0.002.

No approval was needed since this was a rollback to a previously healthy production version (not a first-time deploy).
